contract: Capacity is three units. A queued request may reserve units before its delivery callback runs. Cancellation before delivery must return all reserved units; a later delivery callback must not transfer a cancelled reservation. Live delivered owners release their own units once.

expectedFindings.symptom: A three-unit holder blocks a two-unit request.
expectedFindings.source: A three-unit holder blocks a two-unit request. Releasing the holder reserves two units and posts delivery. Cancellation in that handoff window removes the waiter but fails to roll back its reservation; delivery then skips it. A new two-unit request cannot be admitted despite no live owner. Returning reserved units on cancellation restores progress.
expectedFindings.consequence: The supplied contract is violated in the bounded driver schedule; no production impact or permanent leakage is established.
expectedFindings.remedy: Model queued, reserved and delivered ownership separately; cancellation rolls back reserved capacity exactly once before the posted delivery is allowed to transfer it.
